description_en: Updates the description of a specified long-term memory
description_zh: 更新指定长期记忆体的描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun bailian update-memory --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vexxxx --memory-id 6bff4f317a14442fbc9f73d29dbdxxxx --description '我的大模型应用_APP_ID关于B用户的长期记忆体' --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateMemory

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [How to use a workspace](~~2587495~~).
parameters.description_zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见[如何使用业务空间](~~2587495~~)。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the long-term memory belongs. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the long-term memory, which corresponds to the memoryId returned by the [CreateMemory](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 长期记忆体 ID，对应[ CreateMemory ](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory)接口返回的`memoryId`。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the long-term memory, which corresponds to the memoryId returned by the [CreateMemory](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory) operation
parameters.help_zh: 长期记忆体 ID，对应[ CreateMemory ](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/developer-reference/api-bailian-2023-12-29-creatememory)接口返回的`memoryId`
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description_en: The new description. The description must be 1 to 50 characters in length and can contain characters in the letter category of Unicode, which includes letters, Chinese characters, and digits. The description can also contain half-width colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).
parameters.description_zh: 新的描述信息。长度为 1~50 个字符，支持 Unicode 中 letter 分类下的字符（其中包括英文、中文和数字等）。可以包含半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。
parameters.example: 我的大模型应用$APP_ID关于B用户的长期记忆体
